FN-YMTTY62-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 280
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator J.T. 'Jabo' Waggoner
Analyst: Michael Russo Date: 02/24/2026
Senate Bill 280 as introduced would allow certain state employees and teachers to purchase
credit in the Employees' Retirement System of Alabama or the Teachers' Retirement System of
Alabama for up to 10 years of creditable public service performed by paying the full actuarially
determined cost for each year of claimed service. This bill would not otherwise directly affect
state or local funding.
Page 1

FN-YMTTY62-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 280
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator J.T. 'Jabo' Waggoner
Analyst: Michael Russo Date: 03/04/2026
Senate Bill 280 as reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation Education, would allow
certain state employees and teachers to purchase credit in the Employees' Retirement System of
Alabama or the Teachers' Retirement System of Alabama for up to 4 years of creditable
non-military public service performed for the federal government, by paying the full actuarially
determined cost for each year of claimed service. This bill would not otherwise directly affect
state or local funding.
Page 1

FN-YMTTY62-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 280
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Senator J.T. 'Jabo' Waggoner
Analyst: Michael Russo Date: 03/13/2026
Senate Bill 280 as passed the Senate would allow members of the Employees' Retirement
System or the Teachers' Retirement System to purchase credit for up to 4 years of creditable
non-military public service performed for the federal government, upon payment of the full
actuarially determined cost for each year of claimed service. This bill would not otherwise affect
state or local funding.
